items.summary: Rescan with the fixed scan_nvidia: src/libs/cuda/helper_cuda.h and helper_string.h carry the pre-2017 CUDA samples EULA-pointer notice (the known cuda_voxelizer case that motivated the EULA markers). Standing was established by reading, but no recorded ruling exists; needs a person's confirmation. COUNSEL RULING (2026-08-24): swap helper_cuda.h/helper_string.h for NVIDIA's BSD-3-Clause 2022 versions at the tip BEFORE any fork is created; never host the proprietary vintage at our tip.
